mapper.select: SELECT KEYWORD_CODE, KEYWORD_NM, KEYWORD_INFO, KEYWORD_SCORE, SEARCH_PC, SEARCH_MOBILE, KEYWORD_IMG, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PRODUCT tp WHERE tp.KEYWORD_CODE = #{keywordCode}) AS PRODUCT_CNT, (SELECT COMMON_CODE_NM FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL tcd WHERE tcd.COMMON_CODE = TB_KEYWORD.KEYWORD_TYPE AND tcd.COMMON_GROUP_CODE = 'KEYWORD_TYPE') AS KEYWORD_TYPE_NM, INSERT_DT, INSERT_USER_ID FROM TB_KEYWORD WHERE KEYWORD_CODE = #{keywordCode}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'age' AND SUB_TYPE = '10' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS age_10, SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'age' AND SUB_TYPE = '20' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS age_20, SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'age' AND SUB_TYPE = '30' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS age_30, SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'age' AND SUB_TYPE = '40' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS age_40, SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'age' AND SUB_TYPE = '50' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS age_50, SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'age' AND SUB_TYPE = '60' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS age_60, SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'device' AND SUB_TYPE = 'pc' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS device_pc, SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'device' AND SUB_TYPE = 'mobile' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS device_mobile, SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'gender' AND SUB_TYPE = 'man' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS gender_man, SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'gender' AND SUB_TYPE = 'woman' THEN CNT ELSE 0 END) AS gender_woman FROM TB_KEYWORD_SEARCH WHERE KEYWORD_CODE = #{keywordCode}

SELECT DATE, CNT AS TOTAL_CNT FROM TB_KEYWORD_SEARCH WHERE KEYWORD_CODE = #{keywordCode} AND TYPE = 'total' AND SUB_TYPE = 'total' AND DATE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY DATE DESC;
SELECT KEYWORD_CODE, KEYCATEGORY_NM, KEYCATEGORY_MAIN, KEYCATEGORY_RATIO FROM TB_KEYWORD_CATEGORY WHERE KEYWORD_CODE = #{keywordCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CHECKSELECT ( USER_ID, KEYWORD_CODE, INSERT_DT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{keywordCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT KEYWORD_NM FROM TB_KEYWORD WHERE KEYWORD_CODE = #{keywordCode}

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(sub.review_count), 0)) AS pageAvgReview, ( SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(t.review_count), 0)) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM tb_product tp2 INNER JOIN tb_review tr2 ON tp2.product_code = tr2.product_code WHERE tp2.keyword_code = #{keywordCode} GROUP BY tp2.product_code ORDER BY review_count DESC LIMIT 3 ) t ) AS top3AvgReview, ( SELECT COALESCE(t2.review_count, 0) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM tb_product tp3 INNER JOIN tb_review tr3 ON tp3.product_code = tr3.product_code WHERE tp3.keyword_code = #{keywordCode} GROUP BY tp3.product_code ORDER BY review_count DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 5 ) t2 ) AS middlePageReview FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM tb_product tp LEFT JOIN tb_review tr ON tp.product_code = tr.product_code WHERE tp.keyword_code = #{keywordCode} GROUP BY tp.product_code ) sub

SELECT ROUND(AVG(sub.review_score), 2) AS top10AvgScore, SUM(sub.sales * sub.amount) AS top10Sales, ( SELECT SUM(sub2.sales * sub2.amount) FROM ( SELECT tp.sales, tp.amount FROM tb_keyword tk INNER JOIN tb_product tp ON tk.keyword_code = tp.keyword_code INNER JOIN tb_review tr ON tr.product_code = tp.product_code WHERE tk.keyword_code = #{keywordCode} ORDER BY (tp.sales * tp.amount) DESC LIMIT 20 ) sub2 ) AS top20Sales FROM ( SELECT tp.sales, tp.amount, tr.review_score FROM tb_keyword tk INNER JOIN tb_product tp ON tk.keyword_code = tp.keyword_code INNER JOIN tb_review tr ON tr.product_code = tp.product_code WHERE tk.keyword_code = #{keywordCode} ORDER BY (tp.sales * tp.amount) DESC LIMIT 10 ) sub
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN USER_GENDER = 'USER_GENDER_01' THEN 1 END) AS userGenderMCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN USER_GENDER = 'USER_GENDER_02' THEN 1 END) AS userGenderFMCnt FROM TB_USER;
SELECT RANK_NM FROM TB_SCORE_RANK WHERE #{score} BETWEEN RANK_START_SCORE AND RANK_END_SCORE
